_comment: Caption + card look, transcribed from the reference Short
https://youtube.com/shorts/riQ7dLSnogo and reconciled with the CAPTION SPEC in
credit-card-prompt-pack.txt. Reference behaviour that is kept verbatim:
- heavy condensed sans, UPPERCASE throughout, bare on footage (no caption box)
- hard cut-on / hard cut-off per spoken burst, zero fade on captions
- 1-2 lines per burst, 12-18 characters per line
- one accent colour reserved for the key term in a line
- held full-frame cards at the turns, white stat pills for figures
Two deliberate departures, both forced by this pack's compositions:
- captionY 0.24 not 0.82. Track B frames every still 'subject in the lower
two-thirds, two-fifths of the frame empty above' - captions belong in that gap.
- accent is the house terracotta #E85F42, not the reference teal, because the
stills are lit terracotta/navy/cream and teal fights them.
